correctness.rationale: Ten open neighborhoods are precisely triangles indexed by 3-subsets, pairwise edge-disjoint; ten free edge-triangle collapses yield a connected 20-edge graph on ten vertices, hence H1=Z^11 and higher reduced homology vanishes. The oriented rational C0,C1,C2 are induced modules of dimensions 10,30,10 whose explicit Pieri Specht decompositions give H1=S^(3,1,1)+S^(2,2,1). Complete signed fixed-face calculations for all 120 automorphisms, exact class characters and constituent inner products were reproduced by the standalone verifier. No equivariant collapse is assumed.

value.rationale: Petersen/KG(5,2) is the first nontrivial Kneser neighborhood complex in the topology of graph coloring, with maximal natural S5 symmetry. The complete, nonisomorphic 6+5 irreducible classification and vanishing full invariant subspace are natural symmetry invariants not reconstructible from Betti ranks, and a concise induced-chain-module proof explains their origin. This is a canonical complete classification at the smallest meaningful object, not an arbitrary parameter slice, minor numerical increment, or asserted wider-family theorem.
